compositions.prompt: Medium shot of the same man by a wide apartment window at morning, pale Ufa river haze outside, Belaya river panoramic vista, no metro, no skyline of Moscow. He holds a paper floor plan. Confident posture, tailored navy blazer, crisp shirt. Blue #2F7BFF window frame accent.

Outdoor courtyard of typical Ufa panel/new-build houses (Sipaylovo vibe), autumn leaves, playground at distance. Man in dark jacket with a small blue #2F7BFF folder, standing three-quarter, talking to camera. Overcast, honest, not luxury.
Unfinished new-build kitchen-living, white walls, exposed sockets, measuring tape on windowsill. Man leans on a cardboard box, casual jeans, blue #2F7BFF painter tape strip on the wall behind him.

Small real-estate office desk, printed listings in Russian (readable short words only: Уфа, вторичка), blue mug #2F7BFF. Man sits, sleeves rolled, pointing at a number on paper. Whiteboard softly blurred behind, no metro map.
Concrete stairwell of a 2010s Ufa building, daylight from a window, bunch of keys in his hand. Blue #2F7BFF door trim. Close-medium portrait, grounded, not cinematic crime lighting.
Narrow balcony, evening, courtyard lamps, distant nine-story houses. Man in black sweatshirt, blue #2F7BFF badge-like accent on clothing. City is Ufa residential, not Moscow high-rises.
Parked modest car by panel houses, documents on the hood, man explaining with open palm. Cool daylight, blue #2F7BFF folder. No luxury SUV commercial look.
Ufa bus stop with Cyrillic route plates (bus numbers, not metro M logo). Man waiting with a blue #2F7BFF tote, winter-spring jacket. Neighbourhood realism, grey sky.
Kitchen table top-down-ish 3/4 view: notebook with payment scribbles, calculator, tea. Man opposite camera, thinking face, blue pen #2F7BFF. Homey Ufa apartment, not a studio cyclorama.
Plain new-build entrance lobby, mailboxes, stroller, no concierge palazzo. Man holds a hard hat underarm (not wearing), blue #2F7BFF lanyard. Honest developer finish, Ufa.
Low-rise Dema street, private houses mixed with shops, man walking toward camera, light-blue sweatshirt, autumn. Blue #2F7BFF shop sign blur in background, no English.

Indoor portrait, large readable Cyrillic headline integrated as a printed paper taped with blue #2F7BFF painter tape beside his shoulder. Plant and grey tile hint (from blue selfie room) but new framing. Still photoreal, not meme collage overload.
